source.check: returned unopposed (Derry Journal, 7 January 1929: no contests)

note: Retirement by rotation of one alderman and two councillors in each of the five wards of Londonderry Corporation; nominations closed Saturday 5 January 1929. No opposition candidates were nominated, so all fifteen were returned unopposed and there was no poll; eleven were retiring members (Derry Journal, 7 January 1929). No party labels are printed against the names. New member, in place of D. P. Thompson. Returned unopposed.
